```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
View(ny_noaa)
class(ny_noaa)

```


```{r}
date = ny_noaa$date

ny_noaa|>
  select(date) |>
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date),
    day = lubridate::day(date)
  )

```
